scope: An effect's fx2_id is the id it prefers; the Modwerk base gives each effect its own at install (owner, 28 November 2026; docs/OCTATRACK_FX_TABLE_HOOK.md, tools). schema.py's MenuEntry drops its 0x1f upper bound (0x00-0x03 stay refused), registry.modules() refuses a shared id only on a stock effect's (two replacements), and registry.remix() refuses a card remix holding an id past 0x1f (registry.card_ids), since a card image writes stock's 32-entry id tables; two modules on one id in one card remix stay refused by ledger.check, unchanged. Validation only: build_bus.py and ledger.py are unchanged, and registry.modules() under the base commit's two files and under these, in one copy of this commit's sdk/octabam, returns the same 67 declarations (repr with object addresses removed, identical SHA-256 below), the highest fx2_id 0x1f, so card_ids refuses none of them. Every card selection therefore composes from identical inputs through an identical builder. No card image was built and no hardware result is inferred.
